ARTICLE_DOI.$comment: Wrapped in allOf rather than a bare $ref: in draft-07 a $ref makes its sibling keywords, description included, be ignored.
ARTICLE_DOI.description: DOI of the original publication of the experimental data. Becomes bioschema_properties.citation when no DATA_DOI is given, and bioschema_properties.isPartOf either way

DATA_DOI.description: DOI of the dataset deposition with raw NMR data. When present, this is the DOI that becomes bioschema_properties.citation and sameAs - cite the data, not the article. The article is not lost: it stays the parent work in bioschema_properties.isPartOf

DATA_REF.description: Reference to a deposited dataset that has no DOI. Free text, never resolved, and not a substitute for a DOI: an entry giving only DATA_REF still fails the requirement below

DATE.description: Date of the dataset publication (YYYY-MM-DD), retrievable from CrossRef or DataCite

TEMPERATURE.description: Temperature (K) of the experiment. Absolute temperature, so strictly positive

MEMBRANE_COMPOSITION.description: Dictionary of molar fractions of membrane phase

propertyNames.$comment: Shape check only. Membership of the molecule inventory (Molecules/membrane) is a directory listing, so it is checked in code (fairmd.lipids.molecules.lipids_set), not here.

SOLUTION_COMPOSITION.description: Dictionary of ion concentrations in the system

propertyNames.$comment: Shape check only, as for MEMBRANE_COMPOSITION; the inventory here is Molecules/solution (fairmd.lipids.molecules.solubles_set).

additionalProperties.$comment: A concentration, not a fraction - no upper bound.

ADDITIONAL_MOLECULES.description: Dictionary of molecules which are not in the databank, as free text naming the molecule and its concentration

TOTAL_HYDRATION.description: Total hydration of the system (water mass %), so within (0, 100]

anyOf.$comment: A pH range, e.g. 8-10 or 1.3-13.2. Anchored, and each endpoint is bounded to 0-14 like the numeric branch above: a decimal part is allowed everywhere below 14, and at 14 only when it is zero, so 14.5 is rejected the way the numeric branch rejects it.

PH_METHOD.description: Method of pH setting or measurement (buffer / measurement)

REAGENT_SOURCES.description: Description of lipid reagents. Source, purity, etc.

SAMPLE_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol for sample preparation (in free format, references are welcome)

allOf.$comment: The docs make an explanation obligatory when METHOD uses see_comments for SUBMETHOD.

T_RF_HEATING.$comment: UNKNOWN / measured / guessed, or a free-text description of how the heating was checked - deliberately not an enum.

METHOD.description: Field identifying the NMR method used (formatted as METHOD:SUBMETHOD, e.g., '2H:QE').

SIGN_MEASURED.$comment: The method name if the order parameter sign was measured, NONE otherwise - deliberately not an enum.

bioschema_properties.$comment: Bioschemas Dataset profile 1.0-RELEASE (https://bioschemas.org/profiles/Dataset/1.0-RELEASE). Written by the metadata enrichment tooling, not user-given. Only properties of that profile are accepted, plus dct:-prefixed DCMI terms and the local _source key. Not required, because the profile Minimum properties @context, @type, @id, dct:conformsTo, url and identifier are not emitted yet. Kept in sync with the same block in readme_yaml_schema.json, articleLicense aside, which is experiment-only; test_the_two_schemas_agree_on_the_bioschema_block enforces it.

accessRights.$comment: Not a schema.org term (this is DCMI dct:accessRights). Accepted for now; migrate to dct:accessRights, or to schema.org conditionsOfAccess / isAccessibleForFree.

articleLicense.$comment: Not a schema.org term. The licence of the article the data belongs to should live on isPartOf.license - remap when the enrichment tooling is next touched.

allOf.$comment: At least one of the two DOIs has to be given. DATA_REF does not count: it is free text rather than a resolvable identifier. Where both DOIs are given, DATA_DOI wins as the DOI to cite and ARTICLE_DOI stays the parent work - see docs/src/schemas/experiment_metadata.md and record_dois() in developer/expsim_metadata/fields.py.
An entry describes exactly one kind of measurement.
How the pH was set or measured has to be stated whenever the pH itself is known.

doi.$comment: Bare DOI: no doi: prefix and no https://doi.org/ URL. Mirrors DOI_RE in developer/expsim_metadata/constants.py. Experiment-local - not part of the bioschema_properties block mirrored in readme_yaml_schema.json.

agent.$comment: schema.org Person or Organization. Used for creator, publisher and maintainer.

creativeWorkRef.$comment: A schema.org CreativeWork node, or a bare string (DOI or URL). Used for license, citation, isBasedOn, isPartOf and hasPart.

spdx.$comment: Local extension: SPDX licence identifier. Not a schema.org property of CreativeWork; identifier is the conformant home for it.

partialDate.$comment: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Must stay quoted in YAML: PyYAML parses an unquoted YYYY-MM-DD into datetime.date, which check-jsonschema then rejects as a non-string.

sourceProvenance.$comment: Local bookkeeping written by the metadata enrichment tooling: which API the record came from and when. Not a schema.org term - strip it before serialising JSON-LD.
